candidate: Raw daily Terra MODIS March snow detection -> subsequent April-July San Joaquin full-natural runoff at Friant (CDEC SBF)
prior_selection: Continuation after earlier satellite mechanisms failed; SPIRES rejected for future same-year background inputs; this raw daily product selected on physical mechanism and data access only.
forecast_issue: April1 each year; no satellite acquisition later than March31
predictor: Terra-only MOD10A1 Collection6.1 NDSI_Snow_Cover, daily March1-31 over authoritative upstream Friant basin polygon. Modern reprocessing accepted for scientific current-vintage forecasting; historical first-release availability explicitly not certified.
snow_rule: Use screened NDSI_Snow_Cover values0-100 with Basic_QA0or1; snow presence=screenedNDSI>0. Do not misread NDSI as percent fractional snow cover. For each equal-area basin pixel average daily presence across valid March observations, requiring at least3 valid days. Basin predictor is unweightedmean of these per-pixel frequencies; at least90percent basin pixels must qualify. Cloud/no-decision/night/water/fill are missing, never snow-free. No data fromAprilor later; no gapfilling fromfuture days.
basin: Authoritative upstream basin of USGS11251000 San Joaquin River below Friant / CDEC SBF endpoint; source chosen geographically without runoff fit. Ground-source manifest will freeze exact polygon and station before joining.
ground_predictors: Total October-March precipitation from fixed representative upper-basin station or official basin aggregate, chosen by geography and data coverage, not outcomes
Total preceding October-February SBF full-natural flow, deliberately excluding March to avoid relying on immediately released naturalization estimates
outcome: Sum CDEC SBF sensor65 monthly full-natural flow for April-July, acre-feet; current official archive. All4months required.

models.weather_flow: Expanding OLS of runoff acre-feet on intercept, winterprecipitation, preceding October-February naturalflow
models.weather_flow_snow: Identical matched-row model plus one March snow-frequency feature

negative_predictions: Both OLS predictions clipped at0 acre-feet for physical nonnegativity; no learned clipping or tuning
initial_training: Ten eligible complete years beginning2000; first evaluationyear2010 when all10training years exist. Expanding prior-year training only through2025. Allmissing years and abstentions reported. No train/testyear or featurethreshold search.
uncertainty: Paired circular2year block bootstrap of annual errors,10000draws,seed20260927. Compare RMSE and MAE on exactcommon evaluation years; yearly labels, notdailyimages, determine sample size.
gate: Atleast5percent lowerRMSE and lowerMAE than weather_flow; strictlypositive lower95percent pairedRMSEgain interval. Also report comparisonswithpersistence/climatology and any readilypublishedDWRgroundSWE or seasonalforecast as criticaldiagnostics; no original-vintage or market-alpha claim.
limitations: Snow presence/frequency is not snow-water equivalent or depth
Cloud and forest/topography errors remain, despite per-pixel March aggregation
Current MODIS and CDEC archives have revisions and historical delivery times are unverified
Precipitationstation may not fully characterize basin-elevation precipitation; groundSWE/officialforecasts remain stronger possiblebenchmarks
Single basin and small annual OOS sample
Multiplemechanisms alreadyexamined; nofamilywise discovery or financialalpha claim
